Before I make a disposition decision, I need to check with quality engineering and maintenance as part of our standard batch-hold review. Could someone from quality engineering share the latest test results, and could maintenance let us know about any equipment constraints we should be aware of, particularly regarding the thermal oven if controlled rework becomes an option?
